Subject: Warm handoff: Lumina Health deployment — sales→CS delegate + risk triage

Team — quick internal handoff for the Lumina Health deal (RDW-5871). We closed verbal approval last week; procurement is reviewing SOW but implementation timelines are tight. High-level context:

- Customer: Lumina Health (primary contact Emily Torres, Head of Product)
- Expected go-live (pilot): 2025-07-15 (want pilot in prod-facing env)
- Primary use: triage augmentation + clinical note generation for 3 teams (~25 active users initially)
- Committed SLA: 95th pct token latency < 650ms for standard prompts; caching expected to reduce cost
- Billing: usage-based, with reserved burst hours for go-live week (details in SOW)

Attachments: Lumina_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (initial MAP), SOW_RDW_Lumina_v0.9.pdf, integration_deps_list.txt. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5871

Asks:
1) Mina — can you please triage and nominate a primary CS owner (Tessa is cc'd) and confirm availability for a kickoff week of 2025-05-26 or 2025-06-02?
2) Marcus — flag any immediate technical blockers from the deps list that would push timeline past mid-July.
3) Karthik — I'll need one pager of top risks to surface to execs (cost, data residency, API throttling) by EOD Friday.

I'll keep Emily looped for timeline alignment but want the internal runway set.

Thanks — Hannah

Thanks Hannah — received and reviewed the MAP and SOW draft. Quick responses:

- I'll own the triage and propose Tessa Morgan as the primary CS lead. Tessa, are you able to take point?
- High-level success metrics we should confirm with Emily before kickoff: 1) pilot retention (DAU/WAU) target of 40% by day 30, 2) latency SLOs per prompt class, 3) quality evals — we should lock 12 prompt/eval pairs for regression monitoring.

  • Any additional PII/data residency constraints beyond US-only?

I'll schedule a 30-min internal pre-kickoff with Marcus, Tessa and Hannah for Friday 2025-05-16 to align runbook and staffing.

Date: 2025-05-10T12:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Warm handoff: Lumina Health deployment — sales→CS delegate + risk triage

Looping through Marcus' quick tech read: I scanned integration_deps_list.txt and flagged items that can affect July pilot target. Short list:

1) Data ingress: Lumina currently hosts data in us-central1 and wants to keep traffic inside single region. We'll need VPC peering and a CNAME-based cert handoff — this can be scheduled in 2 business days once Lumina network accepts peering request.
2) Auth: they plan to use an internal okta app. We need the OIDC metadata and a test service account by 2025-05-30 for staging tests.
3) Tokenization/transform: their post-processing pipeline currently truncates tokens to 512 — ask: will they allow testing at 1024 for the pilot? Otherwise model selection will be constrained and we may need to shift to half-precision quantized variant (cost/latency tradeoffs).

Attachment: arch-diagram-lumina.png (sketch of proposed peering + proxy flow).

If the OIDC and peering windows slip beyond 2025-06-10, pilot risk becomes medium-high. I recommend we plan a limited-scope pilot (1 clinical flow) if dependencies are delayed. Happy to review in the pre-kickoff.

—Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
